description: A early steam locomotive with a tall black chimney and a glowing headlamp runs along a track through a flat landscape of birch trees. Behind it, open carriages carry men in top hats and frock coats and a few women in bonnets, with a man in a cap at the controls. Thick smoke and sparks rise from the funnel. In the right background is a pale classical pavilion with lit arched windows, and a crowd stands near it under a dusk sky. No visible text, frame or border.
